title: Attack on Titan Director Breaks Silence on Eren’s Voice After 13 Years
content: The voice behind Eren Yeager has been iconic ever since the anime debut, and the director finally reveals why. Even several years after the main story’s ending, the popularity of Attack on Titan only keeps increasing.

title: Sachiko Uguisu's Kaikai Gigigigigi Manga Ends
content: Futabasha 's Comic Action platform published the final chapter of Sachiko Uguisu 's Kaikai Gigigigigi manga on Tuesday. The series follows a trio of high school students who dive into the mysteries of Kaminari City's strange K-Zone, where strange phenomena are said to occur.
author: ANN

title: Bleach Creator Finally Addresses His Influence on Demon Slayer and Jujutsu Kaisen
content: More than 22 years after its anime debut, Bleach has finally reached its conclusion with the Thousand-Year Blood War Arc. The anime released its final part as part of the Summer 2026 lineup and reached its conclusion after a major delay.

title: The Full-Time Wife Escapist's Tsunami Umino Launches New Manga in December
content: The December issue of Hakusensha 's Melody magazine announced on Wednesday that it will launch a serialization of Tsunami Umino 's previous one-shot manga Omiai Tantei Katabiranotsuji Nagi (Matchmaking Detective Nagi Katabiranotsuji) in the magazine's February 2027 issue on December 25.

title: Yuki Amemiya, Yukino Ichihara's My Husband is a Doomsday Weapon Manga Ends
content: The December issue of Ichijinsha 's Monthly Comic Zero-Sum magazine published the final chapter of Yuki Amemiya and Yukino Ichihara 's My Husband is a Doomsday Weapon ( Danna-sama wa Shūmatsu Heiki ) manga on Wednesday.

title: Dragon Ball’s Frieza Armor Is Still Iconic After 28 Years & Here’s Why
content: Dragon Ball Z made its premiere with Toonami in 1998 , and the world was introduced to a vast array of new characters, power levels and looks to the franchise. One of newest wardrobes was the Frieza battle armor, which was worn by invading Saiyans.

title: Digimon Alysion Smartphone Card Game Opens Pre-Registration with New Trailer
content: Bandai Card Games' Digimon Alysion mobile card game announced on Thursday in a new trailer that pre-registration is open in 49 countries and regions. The game is planned for a 2026 release. The free-to-play game will feature online card battles. The game was initially announced during Digimon Con in March 2025.
author: ANN

title: Reiko Shimizu's Himitsu Season 0 Spinoff Manga Enters Final Arc
content: The December issue of Hakusensha 's Melody magazine announced on Wednesday that Reiko Shimizu 's Himitsu Season 0 ( Himitsu - The Top Secret season 0 ) spinoff manga will start its final arc in the magazine's February 2027 issue on December 25.
